note: The objects on the sea (plan 0005, R13a). tools/geo/build.py puts the ships and the boats at random points in their areas (with the seed, so the result is always the same) and writes data/geo/build/sea_objects.json. A point on land, or where the sea floor is higher than min_floor_m, is not used. The pier and the groynes come from OSM. Areas are [lon, lat] points. The areas of the cargo ships and of the fishing boats are builder estimates from photos of the coast: check. The ships are 2 to 6 km from the beaches, because the camera sees 6 km in this world.
